enlist_duty.reason: Built at run time as "taom_enlist_duty_" + id + "_" + suffix. The duty JSON names the title, body and option keys as literals; the success and failure keys are never written out, only composed for the result toast.

character_creation_narrative.reason: Built as $"{{=taom_cc_{StringId}_text}}" and "_desc" for each option in the charactercreation JSON files, whose StringId values start with taom_ (taom_parent_gondor_1 and so on); the ids appear in the JSON without the taom_cc_ prefix.
